summary: The Dimension tool places dimensions on the canvas. One pick previews its own dimension at the pointer, drawn thin with the measured value: a line its length wherever the pointer is, with its horizontal and vertical distances in the right-click menu, an arc its radius and a circle its diameter. A second pick re-evaluates it: two parallel lines take the distance between them, other line pairs an angle, a point and a line a point to line distance, and two points their distance, where the pointer to the left or right of both points gives a vertical distance, above or below both a horizontal one, and elsewhere an aligned one. The preview follows the pointer's offset: distances run their dimension line through it, an angle draws its arc at its distance and a radius or diameter puts its label at it, inside or outside the curve, and on the center itself keeps its leader's default direction; a point to line distance keeps its placed layout. Pointer moves render the preview alone: no graph row, placed dimension or canvas root renders, and no solve or analysis runs. The preview, the Trim, split and extend previews, the drawing rubber band and readout, snap hints, placement guides and the selection box now draw in a shared pointer-transparent overlay SVG above the canvas. The overlay paints on its own layer for the life of the canvas, so a pointer move repaints the overlay instead of the whole canvas, and picks still belong to the canvas. Dragging points or a circle's radius keeps the drag target and snap hint in the canvas, which the solved geometry redraws on every drag move anyway. Shared vertex marks appear and disappear at once on hover, focus or reveal, without their 80 ms fade; a hidden mark is not painted, so revealing one repaints only itself. A click on empty space or Enter places a driving dimension at the measured value through the existing sketch preparation, cancellation and input-version checks, as one edit and one undo step. Enter places wherever focus is in the canvas, also on the geometry a pick left focused; the dimension editor, menus, snap chooser and controls that use Enter keep it. A pick that leaves the focused geometry out of the tab order, as an axis that takes no more picks, moves focus to the canvas, where the pick's keys still work. Dimension then stays active with nothing picked, the placed dimension becomes the selection and focus moves to the canvas, as after a click on empty space, so Enter or a double-click opens its editor. When preparation finds that the driving dimension over-defines the sketch, the tool places its reference form instead and says so; with no reference form it refuses in the solver's own words and keeps the picks. A relation the dimension implies, such as Parallel with a line-pair distance, is dropped when preparation finds it redundant. A dimension that already measures the picks is selected instead of repeated; when it needs a relation to keep measuring them, such as Horizontal for a line whose one end is held from an axis, or Parallel for a distance to one end of the other line, placing adds only that relation in the same edit. A zero distance, a point lying on a line or two distinct points at one position, has no driving form but can be placed as a reference from the menu. Right-click during the preview opens a shared menu with Place as reference, the other dimension types and the relations that fit the picks, listing what does not apply disabled with its reason. Dimension starts from the toolbar or D, from selected geometry or plane references, and from the geometry menu, and it takes a point to the origin or an axis, an arc or circle center to an axis and a line to an axis it runs along in either order. An axis is a line, so a coordinate held off an axis is an ordinary Distance dimension from it: it is drawn square to the axis, from the axis to its point or to the middle of a line Horizontal or Vertical keeps along the axis, labelled with its size, and it is hovered, selected, edited through the shared editor, deleted and offered in menus like any dimension. Its name is Distance in the status line, editor, relations list, menus, definition panel, preview and candidates; the axis appears only in reasons and highlights. Make reference is unavailable for it, with its reason. The editor shows the size and keeps the side of the axis for a number; an expression stays the signed coordinate. A coordinate held at 0 stays the relation On the X axis or On the Y axis and draws nothing. Dimension refuses a point or line lying on an axis and points to Coincident; a line across the axis keeps its refusal and stays pickable so the reason shows. Fix keeps a point where it is as one fixed-point relation; when one coordinate follows an expression, or a coordinate fix already holds it, Fix holds only the other coordinate, as a distance from its axis. The canvas names an axis with its capital, as in Use X axis. Escape drops the picks, then returns to Select through the shared Escape rule; during a placement it stops the edit and keeps the picks. A placement whose document, version, sketch or tool session changed applies nothing.
warning: Potentially breaking for people and automation that drive the sketch canvas: the Dimension tool no longer opens the relations editor. Picking the geometry and confirming now places a driving dimension at the measured value at once, so nothing moves and no editor opens; Enter or a double-click on the placed dimension opens its editor. Placing moves focus from the picked geometry to the canvas, as a click on empty space does, so keys pressed next reach the canvas; a pick that takes the focused geometry out of the tab order, such as an axis that takes no more picks, does the same. Enter pressed on focused sketch geometry that takes no more picks places the preview, and Delete there removes the selected placed dimension, as on the canvas. Automation that waited for the dimension editor after picking, typed a value and pressed Apply should place the dimension, then open its editor with Enter and set the value there. A dimension that would over-define the sketch is placed as a reference where the editor used to report the conflict. The Horizontal distance, Vertical distance and Aligned distance choices for two points follow the pointer position, or the right-click menu, instead of an editor choice; one line places its length wherever the pointer is, with its horizontal and vertical distances in the menu; a circle places a diameter and an arc a radius, with the other form in the menu. Escape with picks drops them and keeps Dimension active; Escape with nothing picked returns to Select, also when Dimension was started from Line, which it used to return to. When the sketch changes while picks wait, the picks and their selection are dropped and Dimension stays active. The Dimension preview, the Trim, split and extend previews, the drawing rubber band and readout, snap hints, placement guides and the selection box now draw in svg.cad-sketch-overlay, a pointer-transparent sibling over the canvas, with unchanged markup and data attributes; automation that looked for them inside svg.cad-sketch-canvas should look in the overlay. Saved sketches are never rewritten, but every fixed-axis relation whose value is not 0 whatever the parameters are now draws on the canvas as a Distance dimension from its axis and counts as a dimension in the properties panel: a point saved with both coordinates fixed one by one, as Fix used to make, shows two distances, one from each axis, and the Fix X and Fix Y checkboxes in the relations panel now add a visible distance. Those relations are named Distance, with the axis among the operands, such as Distance relation 3 · Point 2 and X axis, where they were Fix X or Fix Y; the datum distance editor field is Distance where it was X from Y axis or Y from X axis; and the canvas axis buttons are Use X axis or Select Y axis where they were lower case. The Fix constraint tool now adds one fixed-point relation where it added two fixed-axis relations, so automation that expected two fixed-axis relations after Fix should expect one fixed-point, or one fixed-axis when the other coordinate follows an expression. Dimension now refuses a point or line lying on an axis, which it used to hold at 0; use Coincident. Hidden shared vertex marks (.cad-sketch-point-mark) are now visibility: hidden instead of transparent, so visibility checks report them hidden until hover, focus or a reveal shows them; their hit targets are unchanged. Where a dimension is drawn is not saved; placed dimensions take their usual layout. WebMCP tools, their arguments and results, the CAD schema and saved documents are unchanged. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output.

checklist.schema: No CAD schema change: placements save through the existing set-sketch-relation edit with the existing distance, axis-distance, point-line-distance, parallel, line-angle, radius, diameter, fixed-axis, horizontal, vertical and reference-dimension kinds. Distances from an axis are the existing fixed-axis kind and Fix uses the existing fixed-point kind. The label position the pointer chooses is not persisted; that needs a schema change in a later update. No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol change; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event change. Placement uses the existing cancellable command submission with the document, version, sketch and Dimension session ownership checks; a stale or cancelled placement applies nothing, and the reference fallback retries only after a CadSketchPreparationError, which leaves no history, so the attempt that applies is the only undo step. A placement that reuses an existing dimension adds only its implied relation in that one edit, or nothing when preparation finds the relation redundant. Picks that wait are a pending workflow, so agent mutations return WORKFLOW_OPEN until they are placed or dropped. WebMCP tools and their arguments are unchanged.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Dimension places dimensions from the canvas; the dock dimension editor stays for editing placed dimensions, and the relations panel keeps its commands.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved documents open unchanged, and are never rewritten: saved fixed-axis relations keep their kind and value, and a point saved with both coordinates fixed one by one now draws two distances, and the Dimension tool state is not persisted.

publicNotes.summary: Dimension places dimensions on the canvas with a live preview.
changes: Pick a line, arc, circle, point pair, line pair, or geometry with the origin or an axis; the dimension follows the pointer with its measured value. One line always places its length; right-click for its horizontal or vertical distance.
For two points, the pointer to the left or right gives a vertical distance, above or below a horizontal distance, and elsewhere an aligned distance.
Click empty space or press Enter to place a driving dimension at the measured value. Dimension stays active, and Enter or a double-click on the new dimension opens its editor.
Right-click during the preview for Place as reference, the other dimension types and the relations that fit the picks.
A dimension that would over-define the sketch is placed as a reference, and the status line says so.
A point on a line, or two separate points at one position, can be measured with Place as reference.
Escape drops the picks; with nothing picked it returns to Select.

A distance from the X or Y axis is an ordinary Distance dimension: it is drawn on the canvas square to the axis, and it is selected, edited and deleted like any other. A point held on an axis stays On the X axis or On the Y axis.
Fix keeps a point where it is as one fixed point.
publicNotes.compatibility: No file, schema or tool change. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged. Sketches saved with a point's coordinates fixed one by one are not rewritten; they now show two distances from the axes.
publicNotes.action: Dimension no longer opens the relations editor: pick the geometry, place the dimension, then press Enter or double-click it to type its value. A coordinate fixed away from an axis now appears as a Distance dimension, and Fix adds one fixed point. Where a dimension is drawn is not saved yet.
